Capability ensuring docs workflow dependencies are limited to docs package and component library outputs, not shared scaffolding packages.

nodes.label: migrate-generated-demos-to-script-setup-tailwind
nodes.summary: Proposal to unify generated component demos in sd-vue-docs to script setup lang=ts and Tailwind utility classes, replacing mixed Options API, plain script, local style blocks, and inline styles.

nodes.label: migrate-generated-demos tasks
nodes.summary: Task checklist for demo Tailwind runtime support, generated demo source migration from Options API to script setup, and guardrails/static validation.

nodes.label: migrate-generated-demos design
nodes.summary: Design decisions: single source of truth for generated Vue files, script setup lang=ts migration, Tailwind v4 shared demo stylesheet for both page preview and DemoEditor REPL preview, removal of SFC style blocks, automated static validation.

nodes.label: generated-demo-source-conventions spec
nodes.summary: Spec requiring generated demos to use script setup lang=ts, Tailwind utilities instead of style blocks, and consistent rendering in both docs preview and DemoEditor REPL.

nodes.label: interactive-doc-examples spec (modified)
nodes.summary: Modified spec for interactive doc examples: demo source fidelity must be preserved during migration, metadata and behavior unchanged, normalized source shown in editor.

nodes.label: script setup lang=ts convention
nodes.summary: Vue 3 SFC convention using <script setup lang="ts"> for Composition API with TypeScript. Adopted as the standard for generated demos replacing Options API and plain script.

nodes.label: Tailwind utility class styling for demos
nodes.summary: Using Tailwind CSS utility classes (with sd-vue-docs prefix conventions) to express demo presentation styles, replacing SFC style blocks and inline styles in generated examples.
nodes.norm_label: tailwind utility class styling for demos

nodes.label: DemoEditor REPL preview
nodes.summary: Interactive example editor in sd-vue-docs that loads generated demo source via ?raw import and renders a live REPL preview. Requires shared Tailwind stylesheet injection for style parity with page preview.

nodes.label: shared demo Tailwind stylesheet
nodes.summary: A single Tailwind stylesheet shared between docs page preview and DemoEditor REPL preview, ensuring consistent utility class rendering across both environments.

nodes.label: fix-local-theme-implementation
nodes.summary: Proposal to fix end-to-end local theme consistency: ConfigProvider subtree-scoped theme container, unified theme/theme-mode semantics, docs example alignment, referencing vuetify and naive-ui patterns.

nodes.label: fix-local-theme tasks
nodes.summary: Task checklist: align implementation baseline with vuetify/naive-ui, fix ConfigProvider local theme container, unify docs theme examples, add regression tests. All tasks completed.

nodes.label: fix-local-theme design
nodes.summary: Design decisions: subtree theme container as sole local theme carrier, parent-snapshot + child-incremental-override inheritance algorithm, unified runtime protocol across docs, behavior-boundary testing.

nodes.label: fix-local-theme implementation baseline
nodes.summary: Baseline analysis: vuetify VThemeProvider uses provideTheme for scoped theme context; naive-ui ConfigProvider uses inject+computed merge. web-vue has ThemeProvider forcing light mode when only theme is passed, breaking dark mode inheritance.

nodes.label: local-theme-provider-runtime spec
nodes.summary: Spec: ConfigProvider shall create subtree-scoped theme container when receiving local theme/theme-mode; nested providers inherit unresolved tokens from parent; runtime mode switches stay scoped without cross-scope leakage.

nodes.label: theme-docs-runtime-consistency spec
nodes.summary: Spec: ConfigProvider demo, home preview, and theme editor must share one runtime theme contract; JSON import/export must be schema-safe; docs must describe ConfigProvider vs ThemeProvider usage boundaries.

nodes.label: subtree theme container
nodes.summary: A DOM-scoped theme container created by ConfigProvider when local theme or theme-mode is set. CSS variables resolve from this container instead of global body. Inspired by vuetify VThemeProvider pattern.

nodes.label: parent-snapshot + child-incremental-override inheritance
nodes.summary: Inheritance model where nested providers take parent's resolved theme as base, apply local token overrides, and produce child snapshot. Child unmount does not mutate parent. Inspired by naive-ui ConfigProvider.

nodes.label: upgrade-style-architecture
nodes.summary: Proposal to migrate web-vue from Less to Scss, add ConfigProvider runtime theme object, CSS variables token system, docs theme editor page, and homepage theme showcase module.

nodes.label: upgrade-style-architecture tasks
nodes.summary: Task checklist across 6 areas: theme infrastructure contracts, Scss migration foundation, component style migration, docs theme editor, homepage theme showcase, validation and cleanup. Most tasks completed.

nodes.label: css-variable-token-system spec
nodes.summary: Spec: theme tokens emitted as CSS custom properties with consistent prefix; components consume CSS variables for runtime theming; critical variables include fallback values for visual stability.

nodes.label: scss-style-architecture spec
nodes.summary: Spec: component style sources migrated from Less to Scss preserving public API; build pipeline supports Scss compilation; temporary compatibility mapping from legacy Less token names to new tokens.

nodes.label: runtime-theme-config-provider spec
nodes.summary: Spec: ConfigProvider accepts unified runtime theme object; theme updates applied at runtime without recompilation; theme object supports component-level override blocks with global token fallback.

nodes.label: docs-theme-editor spec
nodes.summary: Spec: docs site provides theme editor page with editable controls and live preview; supports JSON theme import/export with versioned schema; validates schema compatibility on upload.

nodes.label: homepage-theme-showcase spec
nodes.summary: Spec: homepage theme showcase with preset theme switching; presets reuse same ConfigProvider runtime theme contract; includes default and multiple contrasting presets.

nodes.label: Less-to-Scss migration
nodes.summary: Incremental migration of component library styles from Less to Scss, preserving public component APIs, with temporary compatibility mapping for legacy Less token names.

nodes.label: ConfigProvider theme object
nodes.summary: Unified runtime theme configuration object passed through ConfigProvider containing tokens, optional component overrides, and meta. Normalized into CSS variables at runtime. Supports dynamic updates without recompilation.

nodes.label: theme JSON schemaVersion
nodes.summary: Versioned schema for theme JSON export/import. Enables compatibility validation, migration functions for old versions, and stable serialization for editor and showcase.

nodes.label: CSS variable fallback strategy
nodes.summary: Pattern of providing fallback values in CSS variable references (e.g., var(--sd-color-primary, #1677ff)) to preserve visual stability when runtime tokens are absent.

nodes.label: sd-vue-docs
nodes.description: SD Design documentation site built with Astro, Starlight, and Vue. Provides component docs, LLM-optimized endpoints, and interactive demo previews.

nodes.label: Astro Config (sd-vue-docs)
nodes.description: Astro site configuration using Starlight theme, MDX, Vue integration, and Tailwind CSS via Vite plugin. Defines Vite aliases mapping @sdata/web-vue to local web-vue package, lazy demo loading via IntersectionObserver, and theme bridge script syncing Starlight dark mode with sd-theme attribute.

nodes.label: DemoBlock Component
nodes.description: Astro component used in all component documentation MDX pages to wrap live demo previews with source code display. Accepts source and mainFile props.

nodes.label: LLMs Documentation Integration
nodes.description: Custom Astro integration generating LLM-optimized documentation endpoints: /llms/llms.txt (lightweight index), /llms/llms-full.txt (full aggregated text), and /llms/components/[slug].md (per-component markdown). Enables AI assistants and RAG systems to consume docs efficiently.

nodes.label: LLMs.txt Documentation Page
nodes.description: User-facing MDX page explaining how to use LLM-optimized documentation endpoints. Recommends feeding llms.txt first for structure, then per-component pages for specifics, and llms-full.txt only for global context. Includes RAG best practices and prompt examples.

nodes.label: Migrate Generated Demos to Script Setup + Tailwind
nodes.description: OpenSpec change to migrate generated component demo files from legacy Options API / plain script blocks to script setup lang='ts', and replace SFC style blocks with Tailwind utility classes. Covers Tailwind runtime support, source migration, and guardrails/verification.
nodes.norm_label: migrate generated demos to script setup + tailwind

nodes.label: Generated Demo Source Conventions Spec
nodes.description: Requirements specification for generated demo conventions: demos with script logic must use script setup lang='ts'; template-only demos must not have empty script blocks; all presentation styles must use Tailwind utilities instead of SFC style blocks; demos must render consistently in both page preview and REPL editor preview.

nodes.label: Alert Component Documentation
nodes.description: Alert component docs with 7 demos: action, banner, basic, closable, close-element, icon, title, type. API includes props (type, show-icon, closable, title, banner, center), events (close, after-close), and slots (icon, title, action, close-element).

nodes.label: Avatar Component Documentation
nodes.description: Avatar component docs with 6 demos: basic, fit, group, icon, image-url, size. API covers avatar props (shape, image-url, size, auto-fix-font-size, trigger-type, trigger-icon-style, object-fit), avatar-group props (max-count, z-index-ascend, max-style), events (click, error, load), and slots (trigger-icon).

nodes.label: Badge Component Documentation
nodes.description: Badge component docs with 7 demos: alone, basic, color, dot, max, status, text. API includes props (text, dot, dot-style, max-count, offset, color, status, count).

nodes.label: Breadcrumb Component Documentation
nodes.description: Breadcrumb component docs with 7 demos: basic, dropdown, ellipsis, icon, routes, separator, size. API covers breadcrumb props (max-count, routes, separator, custom-url), breadcrumb-item props (separator, droplist, dropdown-props), and BreadcrumbRoute type.

nodes.label: Button Component Documentation
nodes.description: Button component docs with 8 demos: basic, disabled, group, icon, loading, long, shape, size, status. API includes button props (type, shape, status, size, long, loading, disabled, html-type, autofocus, href), button-group props, events (click), and slots (icon).

nodes.label: Card Component Documentation
nodes.description: Card component docs with 8 demos: actions, basic, bordered, content, grid, hoverable, inner, meta, row. API covers card props (bordered, loading, hoverable, size, header-style, body-style, title, extra), card-meta props, card-grid props, and slots (actions, cover, extra, title).

nodes.label: Carousel Component Documentation
nodes.description: Carousel component docs with 5 demos: auto, basic, card, direction, fade, indicator. API includes props (current, auto-play, move-speed, animation-name, trigger, direction, show-arrow, indicator-type, indicator-position) and events (change).

nodes.label: Checkbox Component Documentation
nodes.description: Checkbox component docs with 8 demos: all, basic, control, custom, disabled, group, layout, limit, options. API covers checkbox props (model-value, default-checked, value, disabled, indeterminate), checkbox-group props (max, options, direction, disabled), and CheckboxOption type.

nodes.label: Collapse Component Documentation
nodes.description: Collapse component docs with 8 demos: accordion, basic, border-less, custom, destroy, expand-icon, extra, icon-position, nested. API covers collapse props (active-key, accordion, show-expand-icon, expand-icon-position, bordered, destroy-on-hide), collapse-item props, events (change), and slots.

nodes.label: Comment Component Documentation
nodes.description: Comment component docs with 4 demos: align, basic, editor, nest. API includes props (author, avatar, content, datetime, align) and slots (avatar, author, datetime, content, actions).

nodes.label: DatePicker Component Documentation
nodes.description: DatePicker component docs with 18 demos covering basic, control, date-render, default-value, disabled-date, disabled, extra, month, panel-only, panel-render, prefix, quarter, range, shortcuts, showtime, size, trigger-element, week, year. Comprehensive API with Common props, per-picker props (date, month, year, quarter, week, range), ShortcutType, and string format reference table.

nodes.label: Descriptions Component Documentation
nodes.description: Descriptions component docs with 6 demos: align, basic, bordered, example, layout, single. API covers descriptions props (data, column, title, layout, align, size, bordered, label-style, value-style, table-layout), descriptions-item props (span, label), and DescData type.

nodes.label: Divider Component Documentation
nodes.description: Divider component docs with 3 demos: basic, vertical, with-text. API includes props (direction, orientation, type, size, margin).

nodes.label: Dropdown Component Documentation
nodes.description: Dropdown component docs with 8 demos: basic, button, context-menu, group, icon, position, submenu, trigger. API covers dropdown props (popup-visible, trigger, position, popup-max-height, hide-on-select), doption, dgroup, dsubmenu, and dropdown-button sub-components.

nodes.label: Generated Docs Sidebar
nodes.description: Generated sidebar configuration used by Starlight for documentation navigation. Referenced in astro.config.mjs.

nodes.label: Generated Demo Components
nodes.description: Directory containing auto-generated Vue SFC demo files for each component, organized by component name. Each demo is imported as both a Vue component and raw source string in MDX documentation pages. Subject to migration from Options API to script setup and from style blocks to Tailwind utilities.

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS Setup
nodes.description: Tailwind CSS v4 integrated via @tailwindcss/vite plugin in Astro's Vite config. Used for documentation site styling and as the target for generated demo style migration.

Base component for popup-based components, provides trigger and positioning behavior
Standardized size system across sd-design components
Pattern for invoking components imperatively via this.$component, import Component, or getCurrentInstance()

nodes.label: Spin
nodes.description: 加载中组件，用于页面和区块的加载状态指示。支持容器模式、点类型动画、自定义图标、不同尺寸和描述文案。

nodes.label: Split
nodes.description: 面板分割组件，将面板分割成两部分。支持水平和垂直方向、嵌套使用、自定义伸缩杆。

nodes.label: Steps
nodes.description: 步骤条组件，明示任务流程和当前完成程度。支持默认/箭头/点状/导航四种类型，水平和垂直方向，可切换、自定义节点、描述信息、错误状态。

nodes.label: Switch
nodes.description: 开关组件，互斥性操作控件。支持circle/round/line三种类型、切换拦截(beforeChange)、自动loading、自定义颜色和图标、自定义值。

nodes.label: Table
nodes.description: 表格组件，用于数据收集展示、分析整理。支持排序、筛选、固定列、分组表头、展开行、行选择(单选/多选)、拖拽排序、可编辑、虚拟列表、树形数据、单元格合并、表头吸顶、总结行、分页等。

nodes.label: Tabs
nodes.description: 标签页组件，将内容组织在同一视图中。支持line/card/card-gutter/text/rounded/capsule类型、动态增减、懒加载、不同位置、滚动、hover/click触发方式。

nodes.label: Tag
nodes.description: 标签组件，用于信息选择、筛选、分类。支持预设颜色和自定义颜色(自动适配文字颜色)、可选中、可关闭、边框、省略内容(内置sd-ellipsis)、加载状态、多种尺寸。

nodes.label: Timeline
nodes.description: 时间轴组件，按时间顺序展示信息。支持水平和垂直方向、交替展示模式、自定义节点、幽灵节点、自定义轴线样式、标签文本位置。

nodes.label: Tooltip
nodes.description: 文字气泡组件，鼠标悬停/聚焦/点击时弹出文字提示。继承Trigger组件全部属性。支持12个方位、自定义背景颜色、迷你尺寸。

nodes.label: Transfer
nodes.description: 数据穿梭框组件，两栏布局的多选组件。支持搜索、简单模式、单向模式、分页、树型穿梭框、自定义标题栏和选项渲染。

nodes.label: TreeSelect
nodes.description: 树选择组件，对树形结构数据进行选择。复用内部Tree/Trigger/SelectView组件。支持复选框多选、回填策略、远程搜索、虚拟列表、动态加载、回退选项、Naive UI和Arco Design迁移兼容。

nodes.label: Tree
nodes.description: 树组件，用于层级关系展示(文件夹、组织架构等)。支持复选框、多选、拖拽、动态加载、搜索、连接线、虚拟列表、自定义字段名(fieldNames)、回填策略(checkedStrategy)。

nodes.label: Typography
nodes.description: 排版组件，用于展示标题(typography-title)、段落(typography-paragraph)、文本内容。支持省略(EllipsisConfig)、复制(copyable)、编辑(editable)、标记/下划线/删除线/代码块样式。

nodes.label: Upload
nodes.description: 上传组件，用户传输文件。支持拖拽上传、文件夹上传、照片墙、图片列表、自定义上传请求(customRequest)、手动上传、上传前校验、移除前校验、数量限制、头像上传。

nodes.label: VerificationCode
nodes.description: 验证码输入组件。支持密码模式、自定义分隔符、格式化输入(formatter)、不同状态(禁用/只读/错误)、配合表单校验使用。

nodes.label: Watermark
nodes.description: 水印组件，给页面指定区域加上水印。支持文字和图片水印、多行文本、自定义旋转/间距/偏移、防篡改、灰阶水印、错开排列。

nodes.label: FAQ
nodes.description: 常见问题文档。涵盖受控与非受控模式概念、下拉菜单滚动跟随(updateAtScroll)、虚拟列表使用(vue-virtual-scroller, itemSize/minItemSize)。

nodes.label: Naive UI Migration
nodes.description: Naive UI迁移指南。当前涵盖Ellipsis组件迁移(NEllipsis->sd-ellipsis, NPerformantEllipsis->sd-performant-ellipsis)，包括对应关系、差异说明、迁移示例和建议顺序。

nodes.label: Getting Started
nodes.description: 快速上手指南。Vue >= 3.2.0，npm包名@sdata/web-vue。支持完整引入和按需加载(unplugin-vue-components + @sdata/web-vue-auto-import-resolver)。全局配置componentPrefix。浏览器兼容chrome>=120等。

nodes.label: Docs Index
nodes.description: 文档站首页，使用splash模板，引入HomeLanding Astro组件。

nodes.label: LLMs.txt Documentation
nodes.description: 面向大语言模型的文档入口说明。提供三类入口：/llms/llms.txt(轻量索引)、/llms/llms-full.txt(完整聚合)、/llms/components/[slug].md(组件级)。包含推荐用法、提示词示例和RAG建议。

nodes.label: Controlled/Uncontrolled Pattern
nodes.description: SD Design Vue的受控与非受控模式。受控模式通过v-model或change事件同步值；非受控模式通过default-*属性设置初始值。default-*类属性与受控值同时使用时受控值优先。

nodes.label: Virtual List
nodes.description: 虚拟列表能力，基于vue-virtual-scroller。支持组件：List、Select、Tree及复用它们的AutoComplete、Cascader、TreeSelect。分固定高度(itemSize/RecycleScroller)和动态高度(minItemSize/DynamicScroller)两种模式。

nodes.label: Naive UI Migration
nodes.description: 从Naive UI迁移到SD Design Vue的过程。当前已迁移Ellipsis组件。TreeSelect也保留Naive UI兼容别名(options, filterable, clearable, checkable等)。

nodes.label: Arco Design Migration
nodes.description: 从Arco Design Vue迁移到SD Design Vue。TreeSelect文档包含Arco迁移指南，API命名大部分保持一致(a-tree-select->sd-tree-select)。

nodes.label: LLMs.txt Standard
nodes.description: 面向LLM的文档标准。SD Design Vue实现了llms.txt(轻量索引)、llms-full.txt(完整聚合)和组件级Markdown三种入口，用于AI助手、RAG、代码代理等场景。

nodes.label: OverlayScrollbars
nodes.description: 第三方滚动条增强库，Scrollbar 组件基于它实现。提供 paddingAbsolute、overflow、scrollbars 等配置项，以及 initialized/updated/destroyed/scroll 等事件。

nodes.label: Select Arco Design Migration
nodes.description: 从 Arco Design Vue 迁移 Select 的指南。主要差异：移除了 sd-option/sd-optgroup 子组件，选项统一通过 :options prop 传入；对外 render function 已移除，统一使用插槽。

nodes.label: Select Naive UI Migration
nodes.description: 从 Naive UI 迁移 Select 的指南。filterable→allow-search, clearable→allow-clear, render-tag→#tag 插槽, v-model:value 兼容。

nodes.label: SelectOptionData
nodes.description: Select 选项数据类型，包含 value/label/disabled/tagProps 字段。

nodes.label: VirtualListProps
nodes.description: 虚拟列表配置，包含 items/keyField/itemSize(固定高度)/minItemSize(动态高度)/buffer 字段。Select/AutoComplete/Cascader 均通过 virtual-list-props 支持虚拟滚动。

nodes.label: CascaderPanel
nodes.description: 级联选择面板，可单独作为路径面板使用，适合详情页或组合式表单布局。

nodes.label: Cascader Naive UI Migration
nodes.description: 从 Naive UI 迁移 Cascader 的指南。保留 value/show/filterable/clearable 兼容别名，render-label→format-label/#label/#option 插槽。

nodes.label: CascaderOption
nodes.description: 级联选项数据类型，包含 value/label/disabled/tagProps/children/isLeaf 字段。

nodes.label: ColorPicker Migration
nodes.description: ColorPicker 旧版迁移说明。history-colors→recent-colors, preset-colors→swatch-colors, disabled-alpha→enable-alpha。

nodes.label: cropperjs
nodes.description: 底层图片裁剪库，Cropper 组件基于它封装。提供 CropperCanvas/CropperImage/CropperSelection 等自定义元素。

nodes.label: RangePicker

nodes.label: SDVue Quick Start Guide
nodes.description: Getting started guide for @sdata/web-vue component library covering installation, full import, on-demand loading via unplugin-vue-components, and global configuration with componentPrefix.

nodes.label: SdDesignResolver
nodes.description: Auto-import resolver from @sdata/web-vue-auto-import-resolver that enables on-demand component loading with unplugin-vue-components. Supports sideEffect and prefix options.

nodes.label: SDThemeConfig
nodes.description: Runtime theme configuration interface with tokens (global color/radius variables), components (per-component overrides), and meta (schemaVersion, cssVarPrefix, name). Uses ConfigProvider theme prop as entry point.

nodes.label: ThemeProvider
nodes.description: Component-level theme scoping via sd-theme-provider. Allows scoped theme and CSS variables within a subtree. ConfigProvider also provides theme/theme-mode props for same capability. Does not override body-mounted floating layers.

nodes.label: CSS Variables Convention
nodes.description: Theme tokens are normalized and injected as CSS variables: primary6 -> --primary-6, colorNeutral10 -> --color-neutral-10, borderRadiusMedium -> --border-radius-medium. Covers color, semantic light, and border-radius variables.

nodes.label: Tabs Component
nodes.description: Tabbed content container with types: line, card, card-gutter, text, rounded, capsule. Supports editable mode, lazy-load, positions (left/right/top/bottom), scroll, trigger modes (hover/click). Sub-component: tab-pane with title, disabled, closable props.

nodes.label: Tree Component
nodes.description: Hierarchical tree view for folders, categories, org charts. Supports checkable (checkboxes), multiple selection, drag-and-drop, virtual list via virtualListProps, dynamic loading (loadMore), search, show-line, field-names customization. Sizes: mini/small/medium/large with fixed heights 24/28/32/36.

nodes.label: TreeNodeData
nodes.description: Tree node data structure with key, title, selectable, disabled, disableCheckbox, checkable, draggable, isLeaf, icon, switcherIcon, loadingIcon, dragIcon, children fields.

nodes.label: VirtualListProps (Tree)
nodes.description: Virtual list configuration with items, keyField, itemSize (fixed height / RecycleScroller), minItemSize (dynamic height / DynamicScroller), buffer. Enables high-performance rendering for large datasets.

nodes.label: TreeSelect Component
nodes.description: Tree-based dropdown selector. Supports checkable mode (treeCheckable), multiple selection, checked strategy (all/parent/child), search (local and remote), dynamic loading, virtual list, custom field names, labelInValue, fallback-option. Has migration guides from Arco Design Vue and Naive UI with compatibility aliases.

nodes.label: Naive UI Compatibility Aliases
nodes.description: TreeSelect preserves Naive UI prop aliases: options->data, filterable->allow-search, clearable->allow-clear, checkable->tree-checkable, checkStrategy->tree-checked-strategy, show->popup-visible. New code should use local naming.

nodes.label: Timeline Component
nodes.description: Chronological information display. Supports horizontal/vertical direction, modes (left/right/top/bottom/alternate), ghost nodes (pending), custom dots (dotColor, dotType), label positions, line styles (solid/dashed/dotted). Sub-component: timeline-item.

nodes.label: Tag Component
nodes.description: Label/tag for selection, filtering, classification. Supports checkable, closable, preset colors, custom colors with auto text-color adaptation, bordered, dynamic editing, ellipsis with tooltip, loading state, icon slot. Sizes: small/medium/large.

nodes.label: Watermark Component
nodes.description: Page watermark overlay. Supports text content (single/multiline), image watermarks, custom font styles, rotation, gap/offset, anti-tamper protection, grayscale mode, staggered layout. Uses canvas rendering with z-index control.

nodes.label: Upload Component
nodes.description: File upload component supporting drag-and-drop, directory upload, picture-card/picture-list modes, custom requests, manual upload (auto-upload=false), file limit, before-upload/before-remove validation, avatar upload. Exposes submit/abort/updateFile/upload methods.

nodes.label: Switch Component
nodes.description: Toggle switch with types: circle (default), round, line. Supports before-change interceptor, auto-loading mode, custom checked/unchecked colors and values, icons, text labels. Sizes: small/medium.

nodes.label: Table Component
nodes.description: Data table with columns/data props. Supports fixed columns, row selection (checkbox/radio), sorting, filtering, pagination, expandable rows, tree data, drag sorting, column resizing, cell spanning, sticky header, summary rows, virtual list, editable cells, lazy loading, custom element slots (th/td/tr/thead/tbody). Very large API surface.

nodes.label: TableColumnData
nodes.description: Column definition with dataIndex, title, width, minWidth, align, fixed, ellipsis, tooltip, sortable, filterable, children (grouped headers), cell/header/body/summary class/style customization, render function, slotName, titleSlotName.

nodes.label: Typography Component
nodes.description: Text display with sub-components: typography-title (h1-h6), typography-paragraph (blockquote, spacing), typography-text. Common features: type (primary/secondary/success/danger/warning), bold, mark, underline, delete, code, editable, copyable, ellipsis with rows/expandable/tooltip/css mode.

nodes.label: Tooltip Component
nodes.description: Text popup on hover/focus/click. Inherits all Trigger component props. Supports 12 positions (top/tl/tr/bottom/bl/br/left/lt/lb/right/rt/rb), custom background-color, mini size mode, content slot.

nodes.label: VerificationCode Component
nodes.description: OTP/verification code input with configurable length, size, formatter function, masked (password) mode, custom separators, form integration. Fires finish event when all fields are filled.

nodes.label: Progress Component
nodes.description: Progress indicator with types: line, circle. Supports steps mode, gradient colors (linear-gradient object), animation, custom size (mini/small/medium/large), status (normal/success/warning/danger), track-color, stroke-width.

nodes.label: Radio Component
nodes.description: Single-selection radio button with types: radio, button. Used with sd-radio-group for groups. Supports options prop, vertical/horizontal direction, grid layout, custom radio slot, sizes (mini/small/medium/large).

nodes.label: Rate Component
nodes.description: Star rating component with configurable count, half-selection (allow-half), clear (allow-clear), custom characters, grading (smiley faces), custom colors (string or per-score object), readonly/disabled modes.

nodes.label: Result Component
nodes.description: Operation result feedback page with statuses: info, success, warning, error, 403, 404, 500. Supports custom icon, title, subtitle, and extra action area via slots.

nodes.name: overdrive skill
nodes.description: Push interfaces past conventional limits with technically ambitious implementations — shaders, 60fps virtual tables, spring physics, scroll-driven reveals, cinematic transitions, WebGL/WebGPU rendering, and high-performance data handling.

nodes.name: frontend-design skill dependency (overdrive)
nodes.description: Overdrive requires frontend-design skill for design principles, anti-patterns, and Context Gathering Protocol. If no design context exists, teach-impeccable must be run first.

nodes.name: propose before building (overdrive)
nodes.description: Overdrive mandates proposing 2-3 different technical directions with trade-offs (browser support, performance, complexity) and calling AskUserQuestionTool before writing any code.

nodes.name: browser automation iteration (overdrive)
nodes.description: Technically ambitious effects require active browser automation preview, visual verification, and multiple rounds of refinement — gap between 'works' and 'extraordinary' is closed through visual iteration.

nodes.name: context-appropriate ambition assessment
nodes.description: Assesses four interface types: visual/marketing (sensory wow), functional UI (feel wow), performance-critical (invisible speed), data-heavy (fluidity). Technique must serve experience.

nodes.name: overdrive technical toolkit
nodes.description: Organized toolkit: cinematic transitions (View Transitions API, spring physics), scroll-driven animations, beyond-CSS rendering (WebGL, WebGPU, Canvas, SVG filters), live data (virtual scrolling, GPU charts), custom property animation (@property, Web Animations API), performance (Web Workers, OffscreenCanvas, WASM), device interaction (Web Audio, Device APIs).

nodes.name: progressive enhancement (overdrive)
nodes.description: Every technique must degrade gracefully. Uses @supports for CSS features, feature detection for JS APIs (WebGPU→WebGL2→CSS fallback). Experience without enhancement must still be good.

nodes.name: performance rules (overdrive)
nodes.description: Target 60fps (simplify below 50). Respect prefers-reduced-motion always. Lazy-initialize heavy resources. Pause off-screen rendering. Test on mid-range devices.

nodes.name: verification tests (overdrive)
nodes.description: Five verification tests: wow test (reaction), removal test (diminished?), device test (phone/tablet/Chromebook), accessibility test (reduced motion), context test (brand fit).

nodes.name: polish skill
nodes.description: Final quality pass before shipping — fixes alignment, spacing, consistency, typography, color, interaction states, micro-interactions, copy, icons, forms, edge cases, responsiveness, performance, and code quality issues.

nodes.name: frontend-design skill dependency (polish)
nodes.description: Polish requires frontend-design skill for design principles, anti-patterns, and Context Gathering Protocol. Also gathers quality bar (MVP vs flagship).

nodes.name: pre-polish assessment
nodes.description: Polish is the last step, not the first. Review functional completeness, known issues, quality bar, and ship timeline before polishing. Never polish incomplete work.

nodes.name: polish dimensions
nodes.description: Ten systematic polish dimensions: visual alignment/spacing, typography refinement, color/contrast, interaction states, micro-interactions/transitions, content/copy, icons/images, forms/inputs, edge cases/error states, responsiveness, performance, code quality.

nodes.name: interaction states checklist
nodes.description: Every interactive element needs: default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, error, success states. Missing states create confusion.

nodes.name: polish checklist
nodes.description: 20-item systematic polish checklist covering alignment, spacing, typography, states, transitions, copy, icons, forms, errors, loading, touch targets, contrast, keyboard nav, focus, console errors, layout shift, browser support, reduced motion, code quality.

nodes.name: final verification (polish)
nodes.description: Before marking done: use it yourself, test on real devices, get fresh eyes review, compare to design, check all states (not just happy path).

nodes.name: quieter skill
nodes.description: Tone down overly bold or visually aggressive designs — reduces color saturation, contrast extremes, visual weight, animation excess, and complexity while maintaining design quality and impact.

nodes.name: frontend-design skill dependency (quieter)
nodes.description: Quieter requires frontend-design skill for design principles, anti-patterns, and Context Gathering Protocol.

nodes.name: intensity source assessment
nodes.description: Identifies six intensity sources: color saturation, contrast extremes, visual weight, animation excess, complexity, and scale. Understands context (purpose, audience, what works, core message) before refining.

nodes.name: quieter refinement dimensions
nodes.description: Five systematic refinement dimensions: color (desaturate, soften, reduce variety, neutral dominance), visual weight (font weights, hierarchy, white space), simplification (remove decorative elements, simplify shapes, reduce layering), motion (shorter distances, gentler easing, remove decorative animations), composition (reduce scale jumps, align to grid, even spacing).

nodes.name: quieter design philosophy
nodes.description: Quieter means refined, sophisticated, easier on the eyes — not boring or generic. Great quiet design is harder than bold design; subtlety requires precision. Quiet design is confident design that doesn't need to shout.

nodes.name: typeset skill
nodes.description: Improve typography by fixing font choices, hierarchy, sizing, weight consistency, and readability — turning default-looking text into intentional, well-crafted type.

nodes.name: frontend-design skill dependency (typeset)
nodes.description: Typeset requires frontend-design skill for design principles, anti-patterns, Context Gathering Protocol, and the typography reference (reference/typography.md).

nodes.name: typography assessment dimensions
nodes.description: Assesses five dimensions: font choices (defaults, brand fit, too many families), hierarchy (distinguishable levels, size contrast, weight contrast), sizing/scale (consistent scale, body 16px+, fixed rem vs fluid clamp), readability (line length 45-75ch, line-height, contrast), consistency (same elements styled same way).

nodes.name: typography improvement dimensions
nodes.description: Five improvement dimensions: font selection (brand personality, pairing with contrast, font-display swap), hierarchy (5-size scale, consistent ratio 1.25-1.5, combine size+weight+color+space), readability (max-width in ch, line-height by context, min 16px body), details (tabular-nums, letter-spacing, semantic token names, OpenType features), weight consistency (3-4 weights max, clear roles).

nodes.name: typography sizing strategy
nodes.description: App UIs use fixed rem-based type scale with optional 1-2 breakpoints for spatial predictability. Marketing/content pages use fluid clamp() sizing for headings/display text but fixed body text. Never use px for font sizes.
